summary: An original-vector search for three historical BC health identities (Kootenay Boundary, Campbell River/Nootka, Sunshine Coast). No original vector was found. It recovered Kootenay Boundary Health's colour website logo of 2002, a different arrangement from the 1998 letterhead, and two larger 2002 originals of Campbell River/Nootka's website logo, added as versions of the 2000 GIF; Sunshine Coast's 2001 banner remains the best reference. Each file was downloaded again from its Internet Archive capture on 22 November 2026 and matches the search's checksum. The search's own README, manifest and findings are kept beside this file.

assets.label: Kootenay Boundary Health: colour website logo, 2002
assets.publisher: Kootenay Boundary Health (Kootenay Boundary Community Health Services Society)
assets.sourceLocator: Site navigation logo (images/nav_top/kbh_logo.gif) of the society's website, kbchss.hnet.bc.ca; homepage captured 19 July 2002, image 12 August 2002
assets.dateNote: The Internet Archive's capture date; the homepage that shows it was last revised 21 January 2002. Neither dates the design's adoption.
assets.notes: Two children with raised arms in purple before teal hills under white peaks, inside a white circle, with “Kootenay Boundary Health” around the top and “together for health” along the lower arc: a different arrangement from the 1998 letterhead, which sets “together”, “for” and “health” inside the circle.
assets.fidelityNote: The archived original GIF, byte for byte (131 × 139 px); its palette includes #330066 and #669999, values in the file rather than print specifications.

assets.label: Campbell River/Nootka Community Health Council: website logo, larger JPEG, 2002
assets.sourceLocator: The council's employment application on its server's historical address (209.52.239.53), which names the council and shows this file; served at 527 × 507 px, larger than the page displays it
assets.dateNote: The Internet Archive's capture date. The file name's “june_00” is not a verified design or adoption date.
assets.notes: The council's salmon over Vancouver Island and the mainland coast, with CR/N CHC, at 527 × 507 px: the same design as the 2000 website GIF, larger, with clearer edges and map detail.
assets.fidelityNote: The archived original JPEG, byte for byte; smoother than the GIF of the same size.
